phaseAssignment.algorithm: sort all frozen support seeds by SHA-256(salt|seed), then assign the first 2048 to namua and the remaining 2048 to mtaji

trajectoryGeneration.policy: uniform random over E.moveVariants sorted by ascending AI.moveKey
trajectoryGeneration.prng: mulberry32-v1 initialized with the unsigned 32-bit seed
trajectoryGeneration.statesInspected: ply 0 through ply 160 inclusive until terminal
trajectoryGeneration.trajectoryDigest: SHA-256 of canonical JSON array of authoritative RAW identity digests

rootSelection.eligible: nonterminal state in assigned phase with at least 2 E.moveVariants
rootSelection.selection: minimum rank within assigned phase; tie by lower ply
rootSelection.duplicateTrajectoryHandling: keep lowest numeric seed; no replacement
rootSelection.duplicateRawRootHandling: keep lowest root-selection rank, then lowest numeric seed; no replacement

baselineInstrumentation.method: load the exact bound public/ai.js text in an isolated Node vm and inject a passive root-return trace sink in memory
baselineInstrumentation.trace: root moveKey and search-return score for each completed nominal root iteration; numeric scores remain transient
baselineInstrumentation.persistedTrace: ordered tie groups only; numeric root scores are not persisted
baselineInstrumentation.featureOffComparator: ordinary require(public/ai.js) analyzeMove on the identical RAW root

ranking.preorder: descending search-return score with equal numeric scores in one tie group; keys ascending inside each group
ranking.changeCount: number of unordered root-move pairs whose <,=,> relation differs between D2 and D3
ranking.top3: flatten D3 tie groups in order and take first three move keys

boundedTop3Probe.semantics: support-only conservative exact full-window alpha-beta per selected root move

publicBudgetSubset.selection: lowest ranks per phase; no replacement
publicBudgetSubset.executionOrder: hard then expert; inside each condition ascending public-budget rank
publicBudgetSubset.reachable: D2 and D3 both completed and the independently reconstructed frozen trigger is true
